name: Plumber Template 1
design_style: Trust-forward family service. Deep-marine palette with a warm orange CTA. Signature live service-area map.
best_for: Multi-generation, family-owned plumbers with a strong local-area identity and 24/7 / emergency positioning.

colors.services_backdrop: purple #7C5CFF to teal #22BED2 over a navy gradient

sections: hero (split copy + image, float card + award badge)
services (scroll-reveal beam rail, liquid glass, one at a time)
service area (live map + animated pins + city chips + offices)
signature_features: Live service-area map (location-tracking.svg) with animated map pins
Scroll-driven 'one service at a time' beam rail with liquid-glass cards
Auto-rotating glass review deck (real Google reviews only)
FAQ accordion (one open at a time, aria-expanded)
motion: Vanilla JS only (no GSAP/Lenis). IntersectionObserver reveal, scroll parallax on services, prefers-reduced-motion honored on every animation.

delivery.remote_images: Pexels (hero, why, about), swap per client
delivery.logo: inline SVG water-drop mark (no raster file required)
